description: This file implements a client for interacting with a documentation language model (Pi) via a subprocess, handling RPC prompts, response processing, and process management.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: Represents a client managing the Pi process, including communication channels, process control, and request handling.

classes.name: piEvent
classes.description: Encapsulates events received from the Pi process, such as responses and agent end signals.

classes.name: agentEndPayload
classes.description: Represents the payload received at the end of an agent interaction, including messages with roles and content.

classes.name: rpcResponse
classes.description: Defines the structure for RPC responses from the Pi process, indicating success or failure.

classes.name: agentMessage
classes.description: Models individual messages exchanged between the agent and the client, with role, content, and error info.

classes.name: contentBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of content in the agent message, typically used for text.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new Pi client subprocess with specified options.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the Pi process and asynchronously waits for the response.

methods.name: Stderr
methods.description: Returns the standard error output captured from the Pi process.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the Pi process, handling signals and process termination.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Collects and buffers the stderr output from the Pi process.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads and processes stdout lines from the Pi process, dispatching events.

methods.name: extractTranslationResult
methods.description: Parses the agent end payload to extract the assistant's response text, handling errors.

methods.name: extractContentText
methods.description: Extracts text content from message content, which can be a string or blocks.

methods.name: decodeRpcResponse
methods.description: Decodes a raw JSON message into an RPC response structure.

methods.name: getDocsPiAgentDir
methods.description: Determines the directory for the Pi agent, creating it if necessary.
